paragraphs: Rav Biva, Rabbi Abba’s son, Vayikra Rabbah 3; Emor 29: Biva bar Abba. The same matter, Jerusalem Ta'anit 2:4: Biva Abba in Yochanan’s name; Heilprin reports Bivin in Rabbi Yochanan’s name in Berakhot, Ellu Devarim, and Kiddushin 1:1. The checked Kiddushin reads Rabbi Bibi. Apparently Bibi bar Avin below, who reported Yochanan.
